changelog: Improve English and Chinese discovery for long-document OCR, PDF/OFD/Office-to-Markdown, CJK text, tables, formulas, reading order, cloud use, and local inference.
summary: Convert long documents to complete Markdown with Unlimited-OCR. Supports images, scanned PDFs, OFD, Office and text files through Baidu Cloud, plus local image/PDF inference through SGLang or an OpenAI-compatible server. Use for OCR, PDF-to-Markdown, Chinese/CJK text, tables, formulas, reading order, multi-page scans, invoices, reports, papers, and structured document extraction.
